Andalusia (Andalucía) — 西班牙旅遊指南：必去景點、交通方式與在地美食

Seville Real Alcázar & Cathedral, Granada Alhambra & Albaicín, Córdoba Mezquita-Catedral, Ronda, White Villages & Málaga. AVE high-speed trains from Madrid to Córdoba (1h45), Seville (2h30), Málaga (2h40) and Granada; Málaga (AGP) & Seville (SVQ) airports.

所屬地區 / 州份Andalusia (Andalucía)
主要交通樞紐Seville Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)
所有城市與市鎮778

交通方式與當地移動

AVE high-speed trains from Madrid to Córdoba (1h45), Seville (2h30), Málaga (2h40) and Granada; Málaga (AGP) & Seville (SVQ) airports.

在地美食與特產

  • Salmorejo & Gazpacho
  • Pescaíto frito
  • Jamón Ibérico de Jabugo
  • Espetos de sardinas (Málaga)
  • Sherry wines of Jerez
